question: Does temporal sensor refinement make the broader measured-grid representation numerically trustworthy under EXP-009's unchanged assumptions?
measured_facts: EXP-008's 857 left and 852 right lens/viewing axes and six-slot neighborhood addresses
literature_constraints: Zhao et al. 2025: locally varying direction geometry; the released eye-to-FAFB map is not an individual MaleCNS body crosswalk
assumptions: Use the exact frozen EXP-008 scene, 5-degree acceptance and 5 by 24 optical quadrature
Use the exact frozen EXP-009 local correlator and lossy type adapter
Keep EXP-005 and EXP-004 downstream operators and all physiological parameters unchanged
unknowns: Individual measured facet to MaleCNS T4/T5 correspondence
Measured left-eye/T5 peripheral functional direction fields
Optical quadrature accuracy at a hard opaque boundary

candidate_declared_before_downstream_eva.selection_rule: One fixed candidate, no search. Evaluate local convergence first. A failure is recorded, not retuned; only a passing local candidate is propagated for an integrated validation claim.
candidate_declared_before_downstream_eva.rotation_reference: Saved 2-to-1ms rotations are historical context only; the candidate is tested at 1-to-0.5ms for all moving conditions.

diagnostic_only_interventions: At original maximum-error neighborhoods: remove occluder
At the same neighborhoods: set lens origins to zero to remove inter-facet-origin parallax while keeping finite-wall translation
At the same neighborhoods: compare 5x24, 9x64 and 17x128 quadratures

comparison.relative_error: max absolute difference divided by max absolute state across both arrays, floor 1e-12
comparison.sensor_comparison: Hold each light series causally on the same 0.5ms neural grid; compare at coincident output times, without interpolation
comparison.neural_comparison: Same production 1ms light, causal hold at 0.5 and 0.25ms; compare coincident output times
comparison.light_comparison: Report both coincident physical samples and causal-hold differences; input light has its own normalization and is not equated to a neural state

acceptance.frozen_sources: Verify EXP-009 source/specification and implementation entries plus its committed record before execution
controls: Local invariant preflight including contrast polarity exchange and causal prefix
Stable surviving downstream operators without renormalization
acceptance.negative_result: A localized, quantified local-stage failure under the fixed candidate is a valid recorded negative result. Numerical convergence does not establish biological identity or physiology.

record_generation_gate: Source integrity, deterministic execution, finite diagnostics and local controls pass; acceptance may resolve to either pass or an explicit negative result. No existing record is overwritten.
